data.title: 爱宕 · 梳妆镜前的黑色薄纱夜袍
data.description: 深夜卧室内床头小夜灯光影朦胧。爱宕坐在复古梳妆台前，身上黑色半透真丝睡袍微松，露出极度迷人的胸口曲线与优雅锁骨。黑色犬耳伏在发丝间泛着淡粉色，她手握银梳梳理着黑发，从镜子中注视着走近的你，金眸波光潋滟，展露出成熟大姐姐毫无防备的动人风情。
data.action: sitting at vanity mirror in sheer black silk peignoir, combing long black hair, dog ears lowered with sweet vulnerability, golden eyes gazing fondly in mirror reflection
data.location: romantic vintage bedroom vanity table in soft amber lamp glow
data.lighting: intimate amber bedside lamp creating warm halo on dark silk and fair skin
data.mood: irresistible mature seduction, quiet loving sanctuary
data.promptProse: Sitting at an antique vanity mirror in warm lamp light, Atago wears a sheer black silk peignoir that slips off her shoulder. Her black dog ears twitch gently as she smiles into the mirror reflection with deep, pampering love.
data.animaCaption: Atago sitting at a vanity mirror in a sheer black silk peignoir, gazing fondly with golden eyes.
